anomalies.detail: Whitespace, form-feed characters, zero-width characters, and obvious mixed-script confusables were normalized during ingestion.
Line-based reading prompts and referenced_lines were synchronized to the current canonical line maps after extraction cleanup and OCR normalization.
Obvious reading prompt and choice artifacts such as missing letters, stray pasted options, and malformed punctuation were normalized where the intended wording was clear from the source context.

note: Anomalies record source problems or deliberate normalization decisions. Canonical files should stay close to the DOCX while avoiding silent guessing.
